sentences.text:
The present petition has been filed by the petitioner under Article 226 of the Constitution of India
read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking quashing of order dated
16.05.2023 passed by the Office of Dg Prisons, and for directions to the respondent to release the
petitioner on furlough for a period of three weeks.

2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the application for parole was rejected by the Competent Authority vide order dated 09.08.2023 on the ground of nature of crime committed by him and adverse police report.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner's conduct This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/11/2023 at 23:13:56 in the custody has been satisfactory, as is evident from the Nominal Roll.
He further submits that the petitioner was thereafter also released under the HPC Guidelines and he did not misuse the liberty granted to him and duly surrendered on time.
Learned counsel for the petitioner thus submits that the petitioner be released on furlough to rehabilitation of social ties.
4. Learned ASC for the State opposes the present application in the light of the heinousness of the offence and the severity of the punishment awarded.

5. Status report has been filed and nothing adverse qua the conduct of the petitioner has been brought to light.

6. In view of the above facts and circumstances and considering the period of incarceration undergone by the petitioner as well as in view of his satisfactory conduct, this Court is of the view that the petitioner is entitled to the benefit of furlough.
As such, this Court sees no impediment in granting furlough to the petitioner.

7 . A c c o r d i n g l y , t h e p e t i t i o n e r , c o n v i c t e d i n F I R N o . 7 3 / 2 0 1 2 u n d e r S e c t i o n s 363/376(2)/323/354/366A/377/367/120-B/34 IPC at PS Gokul Puri, Delhi, is released on furlough for a period of three weeks from the date of his release, subject to him furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Jail Superintendent, and subject to the following conditions:-
i.
During the period the petitioner remains out on furlough, the petitioner shall report to the SHO, Police Station Gokul Puri, Delhi on every Saturday.
ii. The petitioner shall also provide the SHO, Police Station This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 16/11/2023 at 23:13:56 Gokul Puri, Delhi with mobile telephone number which shall be kept in working condition at all times and shall not switch off or change the mobile number without prior intimation to the SHO concerned.
The mobile location be kept on at all times.

iii. The petitioner shall not indulge in any criminal activity and shall not communicate with or come in contact with the complainant/ victim or any member of the complainant/ victim's family or tamper with the evidence of the case.
iv. The petitioner is directed to surrender before the jail authorities at the expiry of the period of furlough.
8. Copy of the order be sent to the Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
9. The petition stands disposed of in the above terms.
SAURABH BANERJEE, J NOVEMBER 16, 2023/So This is a digitally signed order.
